title: Quick Start
subtitle: useForm + FormProvider + useField
description: Wire a React form with fine-grained field subscriptions.
content: `useForm` creates the instance. Wrap children in `FormProvider` so `useField` / `useFieldArray` can read context.

sections.title: Batteries included
sections.content: Prefer [useQueryForm](/form-react/docs/useQueryForm) when loading and saving via `qortex-query-react`.
